snippet.title: Claire a la Mode - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Get Claire a la Mode TODAY on Steam for 10% OFF!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2292860/Claire_a_la_Mode/

Claire is finally out and ready to be played by the public! We are so excited about how this game turned out - it took a while, but hopefully that time was well worth it. In the game there are three unqiue storylines to play through, additional challenge levels to try your skill, and several guest characters hiding throughout the game!

Let us know what you're most excited for or what you think of the game in the comments below!
